variogram_parameters.disclaimer: Derived from borehole core assays. Satellite sensors cannot measure underground variograms.

disclaimer: Satellite and remote-sensing data (rainfall, soil moisture, NDVI, LST, SAR) provide surface environmental context (weather disruption, haul-road friction, pit flooding risks, and exploration drill planning). Satellite sensors CANNOT directly detect underground manganese ore. Subsurface reserve estimation is strictly derived from borehole core samples, chemical laboratory assays, and geostatistical block modeling.
